selected_problem: Fresh-main inspection found pyproject pytest inference remained mutually exclusive with package validation: python -m pytest -q was added only when no package command had been inferred. A mixed JavaScript/Python repository could therefore pass package validation while failing Python tests that acceptance never ran.

decision_provenance.mode_route_basis: The committed four-mode router selects DEEP_DEVELOPMENT through the singular evidence-rich central bottleneck gate; no mode rotation was forced.
decision_provenance.claim_limit: No hosted DWAC success receipt is claimed. Selection/routing use committed DWAC source-contract replay over fresh canonical main while the provider remained transiently unavailable.

pre_fix_reproduction.workspace: package.json with passing check plus pyproject.toml and a failing pytest test
pre_fix_reproduction.observed: inferValidationCommands returned only npm run check because pyproject inference required out.length === 0, allowing mixed-language acceptance to ignore the failing Python test.

changes: pyproject pytest inference now composes with already inferred package validation instead of acting only as an exclusive fallback.
The existing four-command cap remains unchanged, so validation discovery stays bounded.
A regression creates a mixed JavaScript/Python workspace where package check passes and pytest fails; inferred acceptance executes both and fails closed.

validation.tests: 14/14 PASS; 0 skipped on the POSIX validation host

truth_boundaries: This composes the repository's existing package and pyproject validation heuristics; it does not claim exhaustive language/toolchain or monorepo validation discovery.
The existing four-command inference cap can still omit lower-priority validation commands in repositories exposing more than four candidates.
Presence of pyproject.toml continues to imply pytest under the repository's pre-existing heuristic; this change does not introduce semantic pyproject parsing.
This is not an OS-level filesystem/network sandbox; validation workspace confinement remains unresolved.
Arbitrary complex repository semantic synthesis remains UNRESOLVED.
Filesystem crash-level atomicity for arbitrary I/O/process failure remains unresolved.
No GitHub Actions were intentionally triggered or rerun, no force push was used, and no credential, payment, formal Release or destructive/irreversible external action was performed.
